question.text: HWM = Rs. 1.2 crore. Portfolio value Rs. 1.3 crore. Performance fee is charged on:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Under HWM, fee only on gains above the previous peak (Rs. 1.2 crore) — so Rs. 10 lakh here. **The Trap:** Charging on lower base doubles-up on already-charged gains. **Cross-Exam Context:** Standard HWM example. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Keep per-client HWM log; disclose HWM date and value with every fee invoice.
